name: Luzern Risk
summary: Luzern Risk helps businesses form and manage captive insurance companies through a digital risk-management platform.
overview: Luzern Risk is an AI-native captive manager. It combines captive-insurance expertise with a digital platform to help companies evaluate, form and run insurance programs that they own.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Luzern Risk announced the Series B led by Insight Partners; valuation was not disclosed.

bull_case: If more mid-market companies use captives to manage volatile commercial-insurance costs, Luzern can benefit from a technology-enabled operating platform and broker ecosystem.
bear_case: Captive insurance is regulated and operationally complex. Expansion requires sound underwriting, high-quality service and careful compliance, not simply faster software workflows.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: AI-native platform for forming and managing captive-insurance programs.

metrics.label: Latest valuation
metrics.note: Valuation was not announced with the September 2026 Series B

company: Luzern Risk designs, forms and manages captives, which are regulated insurers owned by the businesses they insure. Its platform combines risk expertise, client operations and live program data for captive owners and broker partners.
Luzern announced a $45M Series B in September 2026 led by Insight Partners, following a 2023 seed and a $12M Series A in 2025. It did not disclose a valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Captives let businesses retain more control over risk, capital and underwriting economics. Luzern is a private-market test of whether software and operational expertise can broaden a historically specialized insurance structure.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Luzern combines captive-management services with an AI-native operating platform.
The company announced a $45M Series B in September 2026; its valuation was not disclosed.
Compliance, service quality and broker distribution are central execution variables.
